abstention_semantics: NO_CAPACITY creates no stego replay and contributes zero trusted useful bits

capacity_class_semantics.FLOOR_12_5: normal allocation has no complete word and C >= 64; transmit exactly one 8-bit word
capacity_class_semantics.NORMAL_7_5: normal allocation has at least one complete word; preserve all complete normal words exactly
capacity_class_semantics.NO_CAPACITY: normal allocation has no complete word and C <= 63; abstain

floor_behavior: only when normal allocation has fewer than 8 bits, request exactly 8 coded bits if 8/C <= 1/8 by exact integer comparison
normal_allocation: B=0 if C=0, otherwise max(1,floor(C*3/40)); transmit floor(B/8) complete words
